name: project-manager
description: A working method for running a project through one coordinating Claude Code session (the PM) and several worker sessions (lanes), with a human deciding and git and GitHub holding the record. /project-manager:pm carries the method: the PM plans, reviews, records and relays, and never implements; one independent review plus one review of the changes per unit; evidence labels; plain language to the decider; usage limits and handoffs. /project-manager:pm-setup prepares a project: the settings file, the GitHub Project's Deferred status, and the rulings branch. Four opt-in hooks: a plain-language check on replies and questions, a reminder after GitHub writes, and a barred-folder guard. Depends on simplicity for handoffs.
